race.title: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
race.verdict: TURBOCHARGED confirmed his debut promise when landing a Haydock bumper in impressive fashion in March and looks a novice hurdler to follow this season, as reflected by his inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Onyerbike is a dual-winning Irish pointer who must be respected despite making a belated switch to Rules, while newcomer Biscuit Billy catches the eye on paper and also warrants a close look in the betting. TURBOCHARGED (IRE) ONYERBIKE (IRE) BISCUIT BILLY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Turbocharged (4/9), Bohemond Antioch (5/1), Onyerbike (12/1), St Michael's Well (14/1), Biscuit Billy (16/1), Pedro The Poet (16/1), Reluctantdeveloper (25/1), Royal March (25/1), Rupert The Prince (50/1), Teescomponents Gal (100/1)
